content.title: Understanding MERN Stack Architecture
content.excerpt: A complete breakdown of how MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js work together in real-world applications.
content.body: The MERN stack is a popular full-stack JavaScript architecture used to build scalable web applications. This article explains each layer of the stack, how data flows between frontend and backend, and best practices for structuring a production-ready MERN project.

content.title: JWT Authentication in Node.js Explained
content.excerpt: A practical guide to implementing secure JWT-based authentication in Node.js applications.
content.body: JWT authentication allows stateless and scalable authentication for APIs. This article explains how tokens are created, validated, refreshed, and secured using best practices such as HTTP-only cookies and middleware-based route protection.

content.title: React Performance Optimization Techniques
content.excerpt: Learn how to optimize React applications for speed and better user experience.
content.body: React performance issues often come from unnecessary re-renders and inefficient state management. This article covers memoization, lazy loading, code splitting, and profiling techniques to build fast and responsive applications.

content.title: Deploying Applications on AWS: Basics
content.excerpt: An introduction to deploying web applications on AWS using EC2 and Nginx.
content.body: AWS provides scalable infrastructure for deploying applications. This article introduces EC2 instances, security groups, reverse proxy configuration with Nginx, and enabling HTTPS using SSL certificates.
